content.user_title: Assess Gold Assets and Compliant Financing
content.value_statement: Gold projects combine technical data, volatile economics, and complex financial rules. This skill structures evidence, tests assumptions, and identifies compliant financing paths.
actual_capabilities: Organizes mine reserve, grade, production, and transaction data using JORC and NI 43-101 reference criteria.
Provides methods for estimating recoverable metal, production value, costs, margins, and sensitivity scenarios.
Explains gold-backed stablecoin reserves, redemption, governance, and asset-support structures.
Screens proposals for token financing, unlicensed fundraising, gold trading, foreign exchange, and cross-border risks.
Compares domestic ABS, revenue-rights securitization, supply-chain finance, and licensed overseas structures.
Produces review checklists, compliance-path outlines, financing recommendations, and coordination handoff lists.
limitations: The skill does not provide legal, regulatory, investment, valuation, or licensing opinions.
Project claims, reserve reports, prices, costs, ownership records, and permits require independent verification.
Regulatory summaries may become outdated and must be checked against current official sources.
A worked recoverable-gold example contains a tenfold arithmetic error and must not be reused unchanged.

use_cases.title: Screen a Mine Digitalization Proposal
use_cases.description: Review asset evidence, identify data gaps, and separate digital recordkeeping from prohibited token financing.

use_cases.title: Compare Financing Structures
use_cases.description: Compare ABS, revenue-rights, supply-chain finance, and licensed overseas options under stated jurisdictional constraints.

use_cases.title: Review Gold-Backed Product Risk
use_cases.description: Assess reserve backing, redemption, governance, licensing, and cross-border restrictions before professional review.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Required Gold Project Data
prompt_templates.prompt: List the documents needed to assess a gold project. Group them by reserves, grade, production, ownership, sales, costs, and permits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner intake for a new project

prompt_templates.title: Run a Regulatory Red-Flag Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposal for token issuance, public fundraising, licensing, gold trading, foreign exchange, and cross-border risks. State assumptions and missing evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Compliant Financing Paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare ABS, revenue-rights securitization, supply-chain finance, and licensed overseas issuance for this project. Explain prerequisites, risks, and disqualifying conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Based Project Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged review covering evidence quality, recoverable metal, sensitivity analysis, ownership, regulation, financing structure, permits, and specialist handoffs. Show every assumption.

output_examples.input: Assess a proposed domestic gold token backed by future mine output.
output: Red flag: token issuance for domestic fundraising may constitute prohibited or unlicensed financial activity.
Evidence gap: future output does not establish existing, segregated, redeemable gold reserves.
Alternative: evaluate licensed ABS, revenue-rights, or supply-chain financing with qualified advisers.

output_examples.input: Review a mine dataset containing reserves, grade, recovery, annual throughput, and sale prices.
output: Separate resources from economically recoverable reserves and record the reporting standard.
Recalculate recoverable ounces with units shown and verify each input against source documents.
Test price, grade, recovery, cost, exchange-rate, and production sensitivities before valuation.

output_examples.input: Compare a Hong Kong gold-backed stablecoin with a domestic financing structure.
output: The overseas option requires current licensing, reserve, custody, redemption, and marketing analysis.
The domestic option should avoid token issuance and use regulated asset-backed or trade-finance channels.
Both paths require independent legal, tax, accounting, valuation, and regulatory review.

best_practices: Verify reserve, ownership, production, price, cost, and permit evidence before making quantitative conclusions.
Show units, formulas, assumptions, sources, and sensitivity ranges for every material calculation.
Confirm current rules with qualified professionals in every relevant jurisdiction before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not treat project marketing materials or internal estimates as independently verified evidence.
Do not present token financing as compliant merely because gold or future production supports it.
Do not reuse example calculations without independently checking arithmetic, units, and downstream figures.

faq.question: Can this skill provide a legal opinion?
faq.answer: No. It organizes issues and evidence for review by qualified legal and regulatory professionals.

faq.question: Can it value a gold mine?
faq.answer: It can outline calculations and sensitivities, but an independent qualified valuer must verify inputs, methods, and conclusions.

faq.question: Does it design domestic gold tokens?
faq.answer: No. The source guidance rejects domestic token financing and recommends regulated financing alternatives.

faq.question: Which reserve standards does it reference?
faq.answer: It references JORC and NI 43-101 for reserve and resource reporting quality.

faq.question: Does it support cross-border projects?
faq.answer: It identifies licensing, foreign exchange, customs, gold import, and resident-marketing questions that require local professional advice.

faq.question: Are the included calculations reliable?
faq.answer: Not without verification. One worked recoverable-gold example is overstated by about tenfold and requires correction.
